title.narrative: Youth Employment Promotion through Local Economic Development and T VET

description.narrative: The Multi Donor Action ''Employment Promotion through Local Economic Development and TVET'' is jointly financed by the European Union (EU) and the German Federal Government (BMZ) and implemented by GIZ as part of the broader BMZ Programme ¿Employment Promotion through Local Economic Development and TVET¿. This Action is part of the Jobs and Growth Programme of the EU and the Youth Emplyoment Promotion engagement of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) in Sierra Leone. Overall objective is to contribute to sustainable and inclusive economic development and job creation in selected industries/sectors. The Action contributes to the specific objective ¿improved human capital matching better the labour market¿. The outcome of the Action is ¿Improve youth employability, capacity and systems for skills and increased access to the labour market.¿ Four outputs gear towards this objective: (1) Rapid skills development and employment creation, (2) Effective partnership with the private sector, (3) Improved TVET sector governance, (4) Improved TVET quality and service delivery.
